annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes BitClub paid mining participation with recurring and compounding income claims, including approximately 0.22% to 0.25% per day and automated reinvestment that allegedly grows the investment. It directs viewers to BitClub pages and the description, encourages them to participate as passive investors or join the team, and presents recruitment commissions as an additional income source. The assurance that the arrangement is not a Ponzi or snowball system functions alongside the investment and recruitment solicitation rather than serving as an independent warning.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: S04 is primary because the video links purchasing mining pools or shares to recurring Bitcoin mining income and displays BitClub mining-pool balances, hash-rate statistics, and pool units. S03 is separately supported by the described pool investment and automatic reinvestment returns, while S06 is supported by explicit team-building, new-member commissions, and high-income claims tied to recruitment.
